techniques.name: Finite Cartesian enumeration
techniques.derivation: Retained source operation with explicit local input and execution bounds
techniques.inputs: Ordered named finite lists of distinct string values.
techniques.operation: Visit each tuple in the Cartesian product once, retaining its named coordinates.
techniques.output: Every tuple in the declared domains; empty factor yields no tuples; zero factors yields one empty tuple.
techniques.conditions: At most 4096 tuples in this implementation; all lists supplied explicitly.
techniques.termination: After the last tuple; reject an input exceeding the bound.
techniques.remaining_discretion: Choice and completeness of the domain model are supplied by the investigator, not solved by enumeration.
techniques.verification: Tuple count equals the product of supplied domain sizes; all coordinates belong to their domain; no tuple is repeated.
techniques.transfer_limit: Completeness applies to supplied domains only; feasibility of combinations and adequacy of dimensions require separate findings.
techniques.admission: Admitted only under the stated finite contract.

techniques.name: Finite propositional counterexample search
techniques.derivation: Locally composed finite truth-table method from conditional counterexample search and complete enumeration; no claim of historical novelty.
techniques.inputs: Distinct Boolean atoms, premises and a conclusion expressed with not, and, or, implies or iff.
techniques.operation: Enumerate every Boolean assignment; retain assignments satisfying every premise; return those falsifying the conclusion.
techniques.output: Valid-in-model or counterexamples, plus whether the premises are unsatisfiable.
techniques.conditions: At most 12 atoms and formula nesting at most 64; classical two-valued semantics.
techniques.termination: After all 2^n assignments; invalid syntax or undeclared atoms are input failures.
techniques.remaining_discretion: Translating a prose proposition into the formulas is an independent intellectual operation.
techniques.verification: A returned counterexample has true premises and false conclusion; no-counterexample entails validity only in the declared complete Boolean model.
techniques.transfer_limit: Not a parser, empirical truth test, unrestricted proof search or execution of the entire original ARAW.
techniques.admission: Admitted only under the stated finite contract.

techniques.name: Required-condition candidate filtering
techniques.derivation: Source filtering operation revised to retain unknown prerequisite states
techniques.inputs: Candidate identities with a nonempty map of required checks to true, false or unknown.
techniques.operation: Reject if any required check is false; otherwise retain unresolved if any is unknown; otherwise record that required checks pass.
techniques.output: Status plus the exact failed and unknown conditions for each candidate.
techniques.conditions: The supplied checks are the declared requirements; observations retain their evidence scope.
techniques.termination: After each supplied candidate and requirement has been examined once.
techniques.remaining_discretion: Investigators must justify the requirements and observation values; passing does not establish optimality.
techniques.verification: Unknown-only candidates remain unresolved; one known failure is enough for rejection under a conjunctive contract.
techniques.transfer_limit: Does not infer absent requirements or measure the truth of supplied observations.
techniques.admission: Admitted only under the stated finite contract.

techniques.name: Required-condition achievement assessment
techniques.derivation: Deliberate repair of the incomplete source gate; optional merit separated
techniques.inputs: Nonempty required-condition observations, optional observations and an independent abandonment flag.
techniques.operation: Apply the required-condition status rule; return achieved, not achieved or undetermined. Retain optional observations and activity status separately.
techniques.output: Achievement status, failed requirements, unknown requirements, optional observations and activity status.
techniques.conditions: Achievement means satisfaction of all declared required conditions; input observations are true, false or unknown.
techniques.termination: After the finite required map is examined; empty or malformed required maps are specification failures.
techniques.remaining_discretion: The goal-specific required conditions and evidence must be supplied; no universal 70 percent optional threshold is imported.
techniques.verification: Every valid input has one achievement status; unknown is not coerced to false; optional shortfalls do not negate satisfaction of all declared requirements.
techniques.transfer_limit: A passing assessment proves neither causal effectiveness of the process nor fulfillment of an incorrectly specified goal.
techniques.admission: Admitted only under the stated finite contract.

techniques.name: Alternative support-path preservation
techniques.derivation: Deliberate refinement of downstream pruning into support-path inspection
techniques.inputs: Finite justified alternative premise sets and a supplied true, false or unknown status for each premise.
techniques.operation: Within each path, mark invalidated if a premise is false, unresolved if none is false and some are unknown, otherwise retained. Preserve every unaffected path.
techniques.output: Per-path status and whether at least one declared support path remains.
techniques.conditions: Each path is separately justified as sufficient support; all named premise statuses supplied.
techniques.termination: After every finite path has been inspected once.
techniques.remaining_discretion: Justifying the inference from a premise set to its conclusion is separate; cyclic self-support is not established by this bookkeeping.
techniques.verification: Changing one premise invalidates only paths containing it; an independent retained path survives.
techniques.transfer_limit: Losing all recorded support does not imply the conclusion false or that no other support exists.
techniques.admission: Admitted only under the stated finite contract.

admission_decisions.label: ARAW universalization guarantees all possibilities
admission_decisions.status: Not admitted as a completeness guarantee
admission_decisions.case: Deriving a broad form supplies no enumerator or closure proof for every possible instance.
admission_decisions.repair: A finite declared-domain product is retained as M01; discovering the adequate domain remains study work.

admission_decisions.label: ARAW prescribed rejection or disagreement proportions
admission_decisions.status: Not imported as a verdict rule
admission_decisions.case: A fixed set of valid analytical claims can all be proven; an additional forced false or genuinely uncertain verdict cannot be derived from those proofs.
admission_decisions.repair: Evidence-derived verdicts remain. Counts can describe exploration, but cannot determine which propositions are true.

admission_decisions.label: ARAW conclusion implies acceptance after useful consequences
admission_decisions.case: Consequences conditional on an assumption do not prove the assumption. The original also requires derived verdicts.
admission_decisions.repair: M02 keeps truth of premises, validity of implication and acceptance of the actual premise separate.

admission_decisions.label: GOSM outcome percentage thresholds
admission_decisions.status: Rejected as a complete outcome partition; repaired locally
admission_decisions.case: All required conditions satisfied with fewer than 70 percent optional conditions satisfied matches none of the non-abandoned numeric branches.
admission_decisions.repair: M04 returns achievement from required conditions and reports optional merit separately.

admission_decisions.label: GOSM causal contribution percentages
admission_decisions.status: Not admitted as an identified causal estimator
admission_decisions.case: A template requesting percentages does not supply a causal model, comparison design or identification argument.
admission_decisions.repair: Attribution remains a separate investigative target; no percentages are fabricated.

admission_decisions.label: GOSM immediate pruning of downstream conclusions
admission_decisions.case: A rejected premise can invalidate one support path while another independently supports the conclusion. The source later calls for per-dependent review.
admission_decisions.repair: M05 inspects support paths and preserves independent grounds.

admission_decisions.label: GOSM every tension is a prerequisite
admission_decisions.case: Two alternatives can disagree about a fact that cannot change the selected action or its required conditions.
admission_decisions.repair: A tension becomes a prerequisite only when a case-specific dependency establishes it.

admission_decisions.label: GOSM one uniform system under the name
admission_decisions.case: The archived /gosm is an analysis-depth dispatcher; historical GOSM instructions describe projects, gates and state records.
admission_decisions.repair: Translate both versions explicitly. The /pce dependency of Full remains unadmitted here.

admission_decisions.label: Reasoningtool dimension variation proves independence
admission_decisions.status: Not admitted as statistical independence or full product feasibility
admission_decisions.case: One coordinate can vary while another stays fixed in some examples although a different pair of values is impossible.
admission_decisions.repair: Retain coordinate distinctions; investigate constraints and statistical independence only under their own definitions.

admission_decisions.label: Reasoningtool coverage of examples proves domain completeness
admission_decisions.status: Restricted to coverage of the declared examples or domains
admission_decisions.case: A third omitted example can introduce a new consequential dimension despite complete encoding of the seed examples.
admission_decisions.repair: M01 certifies finite enumeration. The domain-completeness claim remains separate.

admission_decisions.label: Reasoningtool all plausible methods before evaluation
admission_decisions.status: Not admitted as a generally terminating prerequisite
admission_decisions.case: An open-ended method space has no supplied finite enumeration or completion condition.
admission_decisions.repair: Use declared candidate inventories and expansion routes; retain the unresolved possibility of another method.

admission_decisions.label: Reasoningtool agreement across three futures means high confidence
admission_decisions.status: Restricted to invariance within those scenarios
admission_decisions.case: The three scenarios can share a false premise; their agreement supplies no probability calibration for omitted futures.
admission_decisions.repair: Preserve the conditional shared consequence and stated scenario domain.

admission_decisions.label: Reasoningtool complete procedure repertoire
admission_decisions.case: The recovered source reports 415 skills; the separate archive contains 656 metadata entries and seven inspected bodies.
admission_decisions.repair: Unreviewed procedures remain source candidates, not admitted techniques or completed studies.

relations.case: A fixed matter can be investigated by several studies; one study can investigate several distinct matters.
relations.consequence: Subject identity does not determine study method or number.

relations.case: A protocol can exist without a run; a run can fail to follow the protocol.
An investigation can yield a counterexample, a construction, an unresolved result or no informative result.
relations.consequence: An activity record is not automatically a supported finding.

relations.case: A study applies a method to its particular material.
relations.consequence: Methods are reusable contributors, not synonymous with the subjects investigated.

relations.case: A finite coverage finding reveals an unhandled state in the GOSM gate.
relations.consequence: Transferred findings retain their domain and assumptions.

relations.case: A branch-coverage investigation tests the operation used by an achievement assessment.
relations.consequence: Using a technique and studying that technique are different relations.

relations.case: Interfaces, order, conditions and state connect participating operations, artifacts or studies.

claims.claim: Subjects are the fundamental units of this repository's organization.
claims.basis: Stable subject definitions let methods, studies and source families vary while their target remains identifiable.
claims.limit: A subject can be refined further; this does not establish an indivisible atom of reality.

claims.claim: Every system is a set of subjects.
claims.basis: Increment and doubling components with input 1 produce 4 or 3 under two orders; their subject set is unchanged.
claims.limit: A system can be indexed by the subjects it serves or studied as a subject. Neither relation supplies its composition.

claims.claim: Every named project is a conducted study or collection of conducted studies.
claims.basis: The inspected Reasoningtool AGENTS file describes reusable procedures; a stored procedure is not evidence of a conducted investigation.
claims.limit: Some project contents are studies, findings or study specifications. Classification must follow the particular artifact.

claims.claim: A research system can coordinate several studies.
claims.basis: A candidate-enumeration study supplies cases to a gate-coverage study, whose counterexample drives a repaired achievement assessment.
claims.limit: The coordination includes more than the unordered list of study names.

claims.claim: Every subject requires an unrelated method written entirely from scratch.
claims.basis: The same finite Cartesian enumeration supports candidate generation and Boolean counterexample search with different domains and interpretation contracts.
claims.limit: Custom systems still need local targets, inputs, interpretation and success conditions.

claims.claim: The more source techniques we admit, the more capable the resulting system must be.
claims.basis: Adding an unresolvable router branch or a forced unsupported verdict can reduce coverage or correctness.
claims.limit: An added method needs an applicable place and a valid composition with existing work.

claims.claim: Every well-specified technique is well formed.
claims.basis: The GOSM numeric outcome rules are explicit but leave the all-required-pass/optional-shortfall state unclassified.
claims.limit: Specification completeness, coverage and rule consistency are independent study targets.

claims.claim: Every well-formed technique is effective for its target.
claims.basis: A total rule returning one fixed forecast is mechanically well formed and can systematically miss the actual outcomes.
claims.limit: Effectiveness requires the appropriate proof or case evidence, separately from contract well-formedness.

compositions.name: Claim inference finite validity
compositions.subject: Claim inference validity
compositions.flow: Validated formulas supply atoms to complete enumeration. Each assignment enters premise evaluation; assignments with true premises enter conclusion evaluation. False conclusions are retained as counterexamples.
compositions.termination: Complete finite domain exhausted, or explicit input error before a validity verdict.
compositions.case: Five valid analytical implications plus an invalid inference from goal achievement to causal process success.
compositions.standing: Custom specification and executable finite method; scoped cases executed by run_study_cases.py.

compositions.name: Goal achievement assessment
compositions.subject: Goal achievement status
compositions.flow: Required observations determine achievement. Optional observations and abandonment state are retained in separate output fields; neither silently changes the required-condition rule.
compositions.termination: One status per valid finite required-condition map; invalid specifications receive no achievement verdict.
compositions.case: The GOSM threshold gap and all 54 two-required/one-optional/abandonment-state combinations.
compositions.standing: Custom specification and executable finite method; scoped cases executed by run_study_cases.py.

compositions.name: Reasoning candidate finite generation
compositions.subject: Reasoning candidate generation
compositions.flow: Explicit finite domains pass validation and execution-bound checks, then generate every named tuple. Downstream investigators provide the interpretation and any feasibility conditions.
compositions.termination: All tuples produced; empty factor yields an empty space; an oversized or malformed input is rejected explicitly.
compositions.case: Generate the 54 gate-condition cases used by the achievement study.
compositions.standing: Custom specification and executable finite method; actual enumeration used in another study.

admission_rules.name: Defined target
admission_rules.test: The operation and required result have a fixed meaning; a desirable adjective is not an output rule.

admission_rules.name: Declared inputs
admission_rules.test: Required data, semantic interpretation and permitted unknowns are explicit.

admission_rules.name: Executable transformation
admission_rules.test: Each consequential step is supplied, points to an admitted dependency, or declares a bounded discretionary choice with an acceptance rule.

admission_rules.name: Covered conditions
admission_rules.test: Every admitted input has a continuation, result or explicit unresolved/input-failure outcome.

admission_rules.name: Compatible rules
admission_rules.test: Applicable instructions have a consistent interpretation or an explicit justified precedence.

admission_rules.name: Termination meaning
admission_rules.test: Completion, unsuccessful search, resource exhaustion and unresolved work have distinct outcomes.

admission_rules.name: Evidence scope
admission_rules.test: A proof, source description, implemented operation, observed result and transfer claim remain separate.

admission_rules.name: Source identity
admission_rules.test: Original content and scope remain attributable; a repair is a named descendant, not an alleged faithful import.
